attributes.limitations: Only contiguous add/addi/lwz windows, paired at the same offset, are equivalence candidates. Scheduled-apart windows, other load widths and more complex affine chains are outside the census; missing objects and count-asymmetric functions prevent an entire-project absence claim. Equality is normal-completion integer/load behavior, not identical register snapshots at intermediate hardware exceptions. Source impossibility is not established.

subject: function:do_enemy_move
value: Demand census for a narrow three-instruction address-fold proof: one complete-body customer, do_enemy_move,905/905 with three raw differing words. This is a proposal only, not permission to exceed the current WebFrank class ceiling. The read-only symbolic checker proves a common effective load address and all32 final GPR values for arbitrary incoming registers modulo2^32; it accepts only non-record/non-OE add, nonzero-RA addi and lwz, rejects SP/TOC/SDA destinations, relocations inside the window and control-flow entry into its interior. No object is rewritten. A production extension would additionally need target/hash binding, whole-function/relocation/datum gates, adversarial tests, a full forced pin replay and the mod-build bypass check.
